title: Phase 4: Media Upload & Management
description:
## Overview
Implement full media upload pipeline with Cloudflare R2 storage, including image/video processing and a media library UI.

## Tasks
- [ ] Set up Cloudflare R2 bucket and credentials
- [ ] Create presigned URL generation for direct uploads
- [ ] Build upload processing pipeline (thumbnails, optimization)
- [ ] Implement media library UI with grid view
- [ ] Add drag-and-drop upload support
- [ ] Create video player component with controls
- [ ] Add image optimization (resize, compress)
- [ ] Generate video thumbnails

## Technical Details

### R2 Upload Flow
1. Client requests presigned URL from API
2. Client uploads directly to R2
3. Webhook/callback triggers processing
4. Thumbnails generated, metadata stored in DB
5. Media appears in library

### API Endpoints Needed
- POST /api/media/upload-url - Get presigned URL
- POST /api/media/complete - Mark upload complete, trigger processing
- GET /api/media - List user's media
- DELETE /api/media/[id] - Remove media

### Processing Pipeline
- Images: Generate thumbnails (300px, 600px), compress original
- Videos: Extract thumbnail at 1s, store duration/dimensions

## Acceptance Criteria
- Drag files to upload area, see progress
- Images auto-optimize and generate thumbnails
- Videos extract thumbnail automatically
- Media library shows all uploads with filtering
- Can select media to add to portfolio sections

## Dependencies
- Requires R2 credentials configured
- Phase 1 database schema (media table exists)

title: Phase 3: Interactive Portfolio Editor
description:
## Overview
Build a Lovable/v0-style interactive editing experience where users can click elements and describe changes to AI.

## Tasks
- [ ] Create selectable element overlay system
- [ ] Build AI edit panel with streaming responses
- [ ] Implement element-level editing with full portfolio context
- [ ] Add undo/redo history
- [ ] Create quick actions (rewrite, shorten, expand, change tone)
- [ ] Build visual section reordering (drag and drop)

## Technical Details

### AI Edit Request Structure
```typescript
interface AIEditRequest {
  elementPath: string;       // "sections[0].content.headline"
  currentValue: unknown;
  instruction: string;       // "Make this more professional"
  context: {
    fullPortfolio: PortfolioContent;
    userProfile: UserProfile;
  };
}
```

### Components Needed
- SelectableElement wrapper component
- EditPanel with instruction input
- HistoryProvider for undo/redo
- QuickActionBar for common edits

## Acceptance Criteria
- Click any text/element to select it
- Type instructions, see AI-generated changes stream in
- Accept or reject changes
- Undo/redo works reliably
- Quick actions provide instant common edits

## Dependencies
- Requires Phase 2 (AI Generation) for AI infrastructure

title: Phase 2: AI Portfolio Generation
description:
## Overview
Integrate Claude API with Vercel AI SDK to enable AI-powered portfolio generation.

## Tasks
- [ ] Install and configure Vercel AI SDK with Claude
- [ ] Create portfolio generation wizard UI
- [ ] Design system prompts optimized for UGC portfolios
- [ ] Build template system (3-5 initial templates)
- [ ] Implement streaming preview during generation
- [ ] Create API route for AI generation endpoint

## Technical Details
- Use Claude API (anthropic SDK) with Vercel AI SDK for streaming
- System prompts should understand UGC creator context
- Templates define section structure and default styling
- Stream generated content to preview in real-time

## Acceptance Criteria
- User can describe their portfolio in natural language
- AI generates complete site structure (hero, about, work, contact sections)
- Preview shows content streaming in as it's generated
- User can select from different template styles

## Dependencies
Requires Phase 1 foundation (completed)
notes:

- lib/ai/prompts.ts - System prompts optimized for UGC portfolios with niche-specific additions

- app/(dashboard)/dashboard/portfolios/ai-generate/page.tsx - Multi-step wizard with streaming preview

**Features:**
- 4-step wizard: Describe → Template → Generate → Preview
- 8 niche categories for better prompts
- 5 customizable templates
- Real-time streaming preview during generation
- Refinement feature for adjusting content
- Automatic portfolio creation with AI-generated sections

title: Phase 5: Creator Directory & Production Polish
description:
## Overview
Build the creator discovery directory, add analytics, contact form handling, payment integration, and production optimizations.

## Tasks

### Creator Directory
- [ ] Build searchable/filterable creator directory page
- [ ] Add category and tag system for creators
- [ ] Implement search with filters (niche, price range, location)
- [ ] Create creator card component for listings
- [ ] Add "Join Directory" flow for creators

### Analytics Dashboard
- [ ] Track portfolio views (with unique visitors)
- [ ] Show view trends over time
- [ ] Display referrer/source breakdown
- [ ] Add popular content tracking

### Contact Form System
- [ ] Process contact form submissions
- [ ] Send email notifications to creators
- [ ] Build inbox UI in dashboard
- [ ] Mark read/unread, archive messages

### Stripe Integration
- [ ] Set up Stripe for subscriptions
- [ ] Implement pricing tiers (Free, Pro $12/mo, Agency $49/mo)
- [ ] Build subscription management UI
- [ ] Handle webhooks for payment events
- [ ] Gate features by plan (analytics, templates, etc.)

### Production Optimizations
- [ ] Add ISR for portfolio pages (on-demand revalidation)
- [ ] Implement edge caching strategies
- [ ] Optimize Core Web Vitals
- [ ] Add error boundaries and fallbacks
- [ ] Set up monitoring/alerting

## Acceptance Criteria
- Brands can discover creators through searchable directory
- Creators see meaningful analytics about their portfolio
- Contact form submissions notify creators via email
- Subscription payments work, features properly gated
- Site performs well (LCP < 2.5s, good Core Web Vitals)

## Dependencies
- Requires Phase 1-4 completed
- Stripe account and API keys
- Email service (e.g., Resend, SendGrid)
